commit.message:
Verify VSTS get ordinal (#822)

This PR removes trusted `get_ordinal` and consequently we have to talk
about `is_ascii` and:
- add `is_ascii_chars` to `well_formed_for_namespaced`
- add ASCII char check of object name to both model and executable API
server when validating a request
- add trusted parser `parse_usize` from string to int, which
additionally forbid `000` and strings whose integer values exceed
`u32:MAX`
- add axiom `int_to_string_view_ascii`

Some flaky proofs broke and were fixed with adding more
rlimit/decomposition into sub-lemmas/`hide(is_ascii_chars)`

---------

Co-authored-by: Claude Opus 5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
